fields.name: account
fields.description: The rider's login (username). Row access compares it with $user.id.

fields.name: paymentToken
fields.description: Demo card token at the payment provider. A real app stores the provider's customer/payment-method id here, never a card number.

fields.name: account
fields.description: The driver's login (username).

fields.name: ratingAvg
fields.description: Average of driverStars over this driver's rides (rollup).

fields.name: ridesAccepted
fields.description: Rides still linked to this driver = accepted ones (an expired/declined offer unlinks the driver).

fields.name: cancelRate
fields.description: Share of accepted rides this driver cancelled (0..1). The tiny constant avoids a division by zero.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the rider asked for the ride (filled by the platform; the dispatcher board sorts and counts by it).

fields.name: fareCents
fields.description: Base R$3.00 + R$1.20/km + R$0.25/min, times the surge. tripMinutes is filled by the road route (stage 70); before that it counts as 0.

fields.name: riderAccount
fields.description: Login of the rider who asked for this ride. A rider can only create rides for themself (row write rule).

fields.name: driverAccount
fields.description: Login of the assigned driver; set by the platform when a driver is matched.

fields.name: driverStars
fields.description: The rider's rating of the driver (1-5).

fields.name: riderStars
fields.description: The driver's rating of the rider (1-5).

fields.name: pickupDistanceKm
fields.description: Copy of the ride's pick-up distance for THIS driver, written when the offer is made (the driver's inbox reads flat fields).

fields.name: tripDistanceKm
fields.description: Copy of the ride's trip distance at offer time.

fields.name: fareCents
fields.description: The fare the ride showed when the offer was made (a snapshot, not the live derived price).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the offer was made. The driver's inbox counts down 20 seconds from here (the awaiting flow's timeout is the real deadline).

fields.name: expiredFlag
fields.description: 1 when the driver let the offer run out; summed into Driver.missedOffers (stage 50).

fields.name: source
fields.description: Card token at the provider (demo: tok_ok, tok_async, tok_decline, tok_flaky, tok_nowebhook...).

fields.name: multiplier
fields.description: Fixed zone multiplier (airport, downtown...).

fields.name: peakMultiplier
fields.description: Switched by the PeakOn/PeakOff cron flows; 1.0 outside peak hours.

fields.name: peakValue
fields.description: What peakMultiplier becomes during peak hours.

flows.name: RequestRide
flows.description: Asks for a ride and offers it to up to three drivers, one after another. The rider is the signed-in user's own Rider row (MyRider), never a value the client names, so a form needs only the two points. Parks on each driver offer until the driver answers (a human task, or the AcceptRideOffer/DeclineRideOffer screen flows) or 20 s pass.

flows.name: MatchDriver
flows.description: Offers the ride to the closest AVAILABLE driver not tried before. Reads the ride fresh, so a ride the rider cancelled meanwhile is left alone. Creates a RideOffer, holds the driver as BUSY and moves the ride to ASSIGNED. Finding nobody leaves the ride REQUESTED (the flow decides when to give up). Drivers already offered this ride (its RideOffer rows) are skipped.

then.name: notify-driver
args: Pickup ${pickupDistanceKm} km away. Open your tasks and accept within 20 seconds.

flows.name: ReleaseOffer
flows.description: Shared by the timeout and the decline paths: frees the driver, clears the driver from the ride and puts the ride back to REQUESTED so the next attempt can offer it to someone else. Does nothing when the ride is no longer ASSIGNED (cancelled or accepted meanwhile).

flows.name: ExpireOffer
flows.description: awaitEvent timeout path: the driver did not answer in time.

flows.name: DeclineOffer
flows.description: The driver answered DECLINE.

flows.name: AcceptOffer
flows.description: The driver answered ACCEPT in time: offer ACCEPTED, ride ACCEPTED.

then.name: notify-rider
args: Your driver is on the way

flows.name: GiveUp
flows.description: After the last attempt: a ride still REQUESTED ends as NO_DRIVER.

then.name: notify-rider
args: Nobody accepted your ride. Please try again in a few minutes.

flows.name: ReadRide
flows.description: Returns the ride as it is now (the flow's answer).

flows.name: MeasureTrip
flows.description: Trip length and time by road (OSRM). On any routing error: straight line x 1.3 at 30 km/h, marked 'estimate'.

flows.name: OfferCandidates
flows.description: The drivers free right now (at most 3 are offered the ride, one after another).

flows.name: CreatePayment
flows.description: Creates the PENDING Payment for a COMPLETED ride: amount = the ride's fare, card = the rider's token.

flows.name: ChargePayment
flows.description: One charge attempt. succeeded -> CAPTURED; processing -> PROCESSING (the webhook decides later); a transient error (timeout, 429, 5xx) -> RETRYING while attempts < 3; anything else (a decline) -> FAILED with the provider's code. Never throws: the error is captured by errorTarget (K3).

flows.name: ApplyPaymentUpdate
flows.description: Applies the provider's webhook (PaymentUpdated) to a PROCESSING payment. A late or repeated webhook for a payment already final changes nothing.

flows.name: MarkPaymentReview
flows.description: awaitEvent timeout: no webhook arrived in time; a person must look (Dispatcher).

flows.name: PriceRide
flows.description: Works out the ride's surge multiplier (zone x peak x demand) and stores the parts on the ride, so the rider and the Dispatcher can see WHY a price is what it is.

flows.name: SetPeak
flows.description: Peak hours start: every zone's peakMultiplier becomes its peakValue.

flows.name: ClearPeak
flows.description: Peak hours end: every zone's peakMultiplier goes back to 1.0.

flows.name: AfterCancel
flows.description: Runs after a ride was CANCELLED: records who cancelled (from the flag the caller was allowed to set), frees its driver (if any) and tells the other side.

flows.name: NotifyPaymentResult
flows.description: Tells the rider how the payment ended.

then.name: receipt
args: Thank you for riding with us.

else.name: problem
args: We could not charge your card yet. Code: ${failureCode}.

flows.name: RemindToRate
flows.description: 10 minutes after the trip: if the rider has not rated the driver yet, remind them.

then.name: remind
args: Rate your driver from 1 to 5 stars.

flows.name: AcceptRideOffer
flows.description: The screen's Accept button. Runs AS THE DRIVER: the offer is read with the driver's own access (RideOffer rows are visible to the driver they were made to, so another driver's offer is simply not found), it must still be OFFERED and still be the ride's current offer, and the answer is then emitted as the RideOfferAnswered event the parked RequestRide flow awaits -- the event completing the offer's human task publishes -- so the parked flow moves on inside this call (an emitEvent used to be missed by a flow parked for more than about 2 s: REG-340, a UUID in the event never equalled the same id as text in the parked state). A second tap finds the offer no longer OFFERED and is refused. A refusal is a failed read of a ride that does not exist (CONCEPT_NOT_FOUND, 422), the same veto idiom as ValidateWidgetOrderProcedure.

flows.name: DeclineRideOffer
flows.description: The screen's Decline button: the same checks and the same emitted answer as AcceptRideOffer, answering DECLINE (the parked RequestRide flow releases the driver and offers the ride to the next one).

flows.name: RateDriver
flows.description: The rider rates the driver of their own COMPLETED ride (1-5). Runs as the rider: Ride.driverStars is writable only by the ride's rider or a Dispatcher, and the invariant RateOnlyCompletedRides refuses a ride that is not COMPLETED.

flows.name: SetDriverStatus
flows.description: A driver goes online (AVAILABLE) or offline (OFFLINE). Runs as the driver: the Driver lifecycle guard lets a driver make only these two moves on their own row (BUSY belongs to the platform and the Dispatcher).

flows.name: StartTrip
flows.description: The driver starts the trip of their accepted ride (ACCEPTED -> IN_PROGRESS). Runs as the driver: the Ride lifecycle guard requires driverAccount == the caller.

functions.name: demandFactor
functions.description: Demand pressure: half of the excess of open rides over free drivers within reach, never below 1 and capped at 2.5.

functions.name: surgeFactor
functions.description: The ride's surge multiplier: zone x peak x demand, capped at 3, rounded to 2 decimals.

functions.name: fareFor
functions.description: Base R$3.00 + R$1.20/km + R$0.25/min, times the surge (all in cents).
